name: Slack
summary: You can distribute without review. Workspace admin policies are the real gate: strict workspaces block apps that aren't in the Marketplace, and Marketplace listing needs 10 active installs plus a review that can take weeks.

composio.note: Composio-managed works today, but its app isn't in the Slack Marketplace yet, so users see a warning and strict workspaces need admin approval. Composio says a Marketplace review is in progress.

capabilities.label: Post & read messages in workspaces
capabilities.why: Activate public distribution yourself, no review. Some workspaces still need admin approval

capabilities.label: Listed on Slack Marketplace (trusted install)
capabilities.why: 10 active installs, then a multi-stage review

gates.label: Slack Marketplace review
gates.plain: 10 active installs, then a two-stage review.

steps.title: Create the app from a manifest
steps.detail: api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From manifest. Declare bot scopes and redirect URLs (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).
steps.agent: Write the manifest with least-privilege scopes
steps.human: Paste it while signed in and pick a dev workspace

steps.title: Activate public distribution
steps.detail: Slack shows a checklist that has to pass before the button turns on: no hard-coded tokens, an OAuth redirect URL, and HTTPS for every URL. A single http:// redirect is enough to block it.
steps.agent: Fix any check that fails; test install on a second workspace

skip.reason: An app installed only in your own workspace doesn't need public distribution

steps.title: Get 10 active workspace installs
steps.detail: Required before you can submit to the Marketplace, and the app has to stay at 10 or more for the whole review.
steps.agent: Draft the beta invite and an onboarding DM

steps.title: Submit for Marketplace review
steps.detail: Preliminary feedback takes up to 10 business days, then a functional review. **Every resubmission resets your place in the queue.**
steps.agent: Pre-check against the guidelines; write the privacy policy, support page and test instructions

facts.quote: Submission timeline ​ Currently, the preliminary part of the review takes up to 10 business days to receive feedback, while the functional review takes up to 10 weeks for new submissions and 6 weeks for published apps resubmitting changes.

blockers.problem: “This app isn't listed in the Slack Marketplace” or an admin-approval request
blockers.fix: The workspace restricts unlisted apps. Ask a workspace admin to approve the app, or have an Owner install it. The long-term fix is the Marketplace listing.

blockers.problem: Activate Public Distribution is greyed out
blockers.fix: One of the four checks is failing. Most often a redirect URL uses http://, or a token is hard-coded.

uncertain: The total review time across both stages varies. Third parties report up to about 10 weeks.
